description: This file defines a PHP trait named ETagHelperTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Traits. The trait includes a protected method generateEtag which creates a base64-encoded SHA-256 hash of input string data.

classes.name: ETagHelperTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait that provides functionality for generating ETag strings using SHA-256 hashing and base64 encoding.

methods.name: generateEtag
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded SHA-256 hash of the provided string data.
